{{Quote|Rumor has it Jabba hired an off world scientist named Dr. Kaum to come help him develop some weapons technology. Dr. Kaum doesn't know any of Jabba's thugs, so go pick him up before they get there.|[[Ind]]|<ref name="SWG:I" />}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Kaum''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Kaum was an expert in weapons technology and, by the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], his specialty was beam weapons.<ref name="SWG:I" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Dr. Kaum was recruited by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to develop some weapons for his [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|organization]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, the arrival of the scientist on Tatooine was discovered by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], the leader of the [[Valarian Syndicate|Valarian criminal syndicate]] and main rival of Jabba. As the Mon Calamari did not know any of Jabba's thugs, Lady Valarian's lieutenant [[Ind]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with picking him up before Jabba's men. The spacer thus encountered Kaum upon his arrival on [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and escorted him back to Ind at the ''[[Lucky Despot]]''. Unaware that he had been lured, Dr. Kaum later began to work for the Valarian syndicate.<ref name="SWG:I" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaum was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:I" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dr. Kaum was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:I" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" on [[August 31]], [[2005]], Lady Valarian's Quest Series was deactivated and Dr. Kaum was consequently removed from the game.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref>
